## Use Liberation Mono in VS Code

Paste this into your settings to set Liberation Mono for the editor. The fallbacks are the same ones CodeFont writes.

{
  "editor.fontFamily": "'Liberation Mono', 'JetBrains Mono', 'SF Mono', Monaco, 'Cascadia Code', 'Roboto Mono', monospace"
}

## About the Liberation Mono coding font

An open-source font project by Red Hat. Liberation Mono is a free monospace coding font without programming ligatures.

Liberation Mono is not hosted on Google Fonts. The specimen above renders in the real face when the font is installed on your device; if it is not installed, the page falls back to a standard monospace face so the layout stays intact. It is one of the 95 families in the CodeFont catalog.

## Liberation Mono FAQ

### Is Liberation Mono free?

Yes. Liberation Mono is free to use; check the official source for the exact licence terms.

### Does Liberation Mono support ligatures?

No. Liberation Mono has no programming ligatures, so sequences such as -> and != are drawn as separate characters.

### Where can I get Liberation Mono?

Liberation Mono is available from GitHub and Red Hat. The download links are listed in the Where to get section above.
